name: multistep_final_warning
description: Tool-result message used on the model's LAST code turn: delivers the execution result AND warns that no more code turns remain, so the model must decide now. Default `user` role. Variables: tool_content, stdout, stderr, code, success.

chat_template.content:
{tool_content}

IMPORTANT: This was your LAST code turn -- you have no more turns to run code. You MUST decide now. Respond ONLY with your verbal feedback inside <feedback> tags followed by the label inside <label> tags, with no code and no other text.
